notes: Twine is Sasikanth Miriyampalli's Compose Multiplatform RSS reader, shipped on Google Play (dev.sasikanth.rss.reader) and the App Store, and one of the few third-party Compose apps whose visual design is the point of it — dynamic ambient theming taken from the feed's own artwork. :shared applies kotlin-multiplatform, com.android.library and the Compose plugins, and its 22 @Preview functions all live in shared/src/commonMain importing androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview — the multiplatform alias, not the Android-only annotation. They therefore compile into the module's ANDROID variant and render on the Robolectric lane; :shared declares android and iOS targets and no jvm() one, so the desktop lane is not available to it and renderer stays android. jvmToolchain(21) matches the runner, so no javaVersion. Counted in a checkout with the pipeline's own discovery, not a code search: 22 previews in 22 files, each one a whole SCREEN rather than a component — which is what this catalog will show, and the thing to watch on the first render, since a screen preview that reaches for state the app normally supplies is the way an import of this shape fails.
